column1: # key_sabran_1631_letters.tsv -- letter-symbol alphabet of George Lasry's key "BNF Francais 4134" (dated by him
# 25/05/2022), published on S. Tomokiyo's Cryptiana page sources/cryptiana/web/GL.htm, section "Melchior de Sabran
# (1631)"; image cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/GL/BnF_fr4134.jpg (624x261 px, fetched 24 Sept 2026, not committed:
# it is Lasry's work, cite and link it). Transcribed 24 Sept 2026 by LANE G3 worker C from a 3.5x browser zoom.
# One row per glyph, top to bottom in each column. `glyph` describes the hand-drawn shape; `grade` M throughout
# because the published image is small (each glyph ~15 px) -- the letter column headings are Lasry's, typed.
# `dc8_token`: the DC8 (Baluze 156 f.157r) transcription token this glyph was matched to by shape, '-' if no
# DC8 token resembles it. Several DC8 tokens compete for one key glyph (see note); the first-listed is used.
# The two lower-case columns "d" and "p" are Lasry's own headings (second homophones for D and P, or signs he
# kept apart); treated as D and P here.
